title: Quaint Sweet Korean Noodles Naengmyeon
description: A sweet and shaggy lacto-vegetarian Korean dish featuring speculaas spice mix, served cold and perfect for meal prep. This naengmyeon recipe is a unique twist on traditional Korean noodles.
instructions: In a large pot, bring water to a boil and cook the naengmyeon noodles according to package instructions.
In a small bowl, whisk together speculaas spice mix, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and honey to make the sauce.
In a bain-marie, warm the sesame oil over low heat.
Add the toasted sesame seeds to the warmed sesame oil and stir to combine.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked noodles, speculaas sauce, and sesame oil mixture.
Top the noodles with grated carrot, cucumber slices, sliced hard boiled egg, and pear slices.
Refrigerate the naengmyeon for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, garnish with additional toasted sesame seeds and speculaas spice mix if desired.
Serve the quaint sweet Korean noodles naengmyeon cold and enjoy.
